steps.caption: Pipeline
steps.narration: The Costing tab tracks what a job costs you. Here is how to post to it.

steps.caption: Open the project
steps.narration: Open the job from the Pipeline. We'll use the Ellison job.

steps.caption: No costs yet
steps.narration: No costs are posted yet, so there is no profit figure.

steps.caption: Entry row
steps.narration: On the Costing tab, the entry row adds a line to the job.

steps.caption: Committed
steps.narration: In Entry, choose Committed for a purchase order or a subcontract.

steps.caption: Cost code
steps.narration: Pick the cost code. This one is Flooring.

steps.caption: Description
steps.narration: Name the vendor or the order.

steps.caption: Committed line
steps.narration: The Flooring line now shows the order under Committed.

steps.caption: Vendor bill
steps.narration: When a bill arrives, choose Actual, vendor bill.

steps.caption: Description
steps.narration: Say what the bill is for.

steps.caption: Add
steps.narration: And click the plus button again.

steps.caption: Actual line
steps.narration: The bill is under Actual on the same line.

steps.caption: Gross profit
steps.narration: Now the page shows gross profit and the margin.

steps.caption: Menu: Pipeline
steps.narration: Open any job from Pipeline, in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to post job costs to a project | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of the Costing tab in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will add a purchase order as a commitment, post a vendor bill as an actual cost, and see gross profit and margin appear on the project.
